WPFTweaksWindowsUpdateDefer.Content: Windows Update - Defer Feature (365 days) and Quality (4 days) Updates
WPFTweaksWindowsUpdateDefer.Description: Delays feature updates by a year and quality/security updates by 4 days, so broken releases are usually pulled before they reach this PC, and only notifies when downloaded updates are ready to install. Same deferral as WinUtil's 'Security settings' button, without blocking drivers. These are Windows Update for Business policies, which Windows Home editions may ignore.
WPFTweaksWindowsUpdateDefer.Origen: Video Chris Titus 07:31 (botón Updates > Security settings)

WPFTweaksWindowsUpdateNoDrivers.Description: Stops Windows Update from installing or offering drivers, so drivers are only changed when you install them yourself. To also stop device companion apps and metadata downloads, use 'Prevent Device Companion Apps'. On a fresh install, run Windows Update once first or have your network and chipset drivers ready, or some devices may be left without a driver.
